tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// drag po gsum sgril bsgom par 'dod pas/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing ga zhig tu bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib dag gnod byed bgegs rnams la phog de rnams btul/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu/ dngos grub thams cad tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ 'od du zhu ba las/ rang skad cig gis gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon rjes su bstan pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gdengs pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil ba'i gseb na rta mgo yod pa/ rta skad lan gsum 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ g.yas su rta skad bton pas pho rgyud dbang du sdud pa/ g.yon du rta skad bton pas mo rgyud dbang du sdud pa/ dbus su rta skad bton pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba/ rta mgo'i spyi gtsug tu bya khyung rgyal po sku mdog dkar po gshog sgro ral gri las byas pa/ g.yu'i rwa ru can/ rwa phrag na rin po che 'bar bas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis klu rigs bzhi zhal du gsol ba/ mchu sder rdo rje las byas pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ba spu thams cad 'khor lo dang rdo rje spu gri'i rnam pa/ klu rigs lngas yan lag brgyan pa/ gsang bdag gi dbu skra sbrul rgyal rigs dkar khras brgyan pa/ rje rigs ser khras snyan rgyan dang dpung rgyan/

bram ze'i rigs dmar khras mgul rgyan dang ska rags/ dmangs rigs ljang khras phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/ gdol pa nag pos do shal byas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me phung gi dkyil na bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i thugs kar pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i phyag na rdo rje spyan drangs/ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa phul nas/ bdag la mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyi bor byon zhing thim par bsam/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi ha ya grī wa ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag cing nad gdon thams cad bsregs par bsams la/ gong gi sngags ngag bcad la 'bad pa drag pos bgrang ngo*// de ltar byas pas phyag na rdo rjes gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams 'dul/ rta mgos rgyal bsen gyi gdon rnams 'dul/ bya khyung gis klu'i gdon rnams 'dul/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlob pa yin/ gnyen po'i lha gsum byin rlabs shin tu che/ dngos grub myur bas 'bad pa gal che/ drag po sum sgril gyi dmigs pa las kyi rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa yin no// 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs par gyur cig/ ༈ /dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje pha lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ rigs kyi khyab bdag mi bskyod rgyal po nyid// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shar// gsang ba kun 'dzin las kyi rdo rje dang*// drin can bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal kun mthu stobs khro chu 'bar ba'i rgyun// 'jigs rungs gzugs kyi gar bu gcig 'khyil ba// dran pa yis kyang steng 'og bar gyi gdon// mthar mdzad gsang ba'i bdag por gus pas 'dud// rnam dag chos kyi sku mnga' khro rgyal de'i// sprul gzugs nam mkha'i 'jug par mnyam pa las// gtum chen drag po'i lha gsum gcig bsgril du// shar pa'i sgrub thabs snying po 'di na spel// 'dir gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems kyis 'gro ba thams cad la ma bu gcig pa ltar dgongs shing mthu stobs dang mkhyen pa'i yon tan dpag gis mi lang ba'i grub chen las kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba de nyid ring mo zhig nas dpal gsang ba'i bdag por mngon par byang chub zin na'ang tha mal bshes gnyen gyi tshul bzung ba'i sku tshe de la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku'i snang ba nam 'dod du gzigs nas theg pa chen po'i chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan pa las/

snyan brgyud glegs bam du bzhugs pa'i nang tshan phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi bsgom bzlas nyams su len pa la rten gyi gang zag dbang gis rgyud smin cing*/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pas yid mthun gyi gnas su yi dam gyi sku dang*/ mchod gtor sogs legs par bsham/ stan bde ba la 'khod nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar sngon du btang ste/ snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems dung nge ba'i ngang nas 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o// oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ yig mthing ga de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i go 'phang la bkod cing*/ gnod byed rnams la phog pas de thams cad btul/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rjes su bstan pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gdengs pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil ba'i gseb na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad lan gsum 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ g.yas su rta skad bton pas pho rgyud dang*/ g.yon du rta skad bton pas mo rgyud dbang du sdud cing*/ dbus su rta skad bton pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba/ rta mgo'i spyi gtsug tu bya khyung rgyal po sku mdog dkar po spyan gsum pa/

gshog sgro ral gri las byas shing*/ g.yu'i rwa ru can/ rwa dbrag na rin po che 'bar bas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis klu rigs bzhi zhal du gsol ba/ mchu sder rdo rje las byas pa/ ba spu thams cad 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang spu gri'i rnam pa can/ klu rigs lngas yan lag brgyan pa/ gsang bdag gi dbu skra la sbrul rgyal rigs dkar khras brgyan cing*/ rje rigs ser khras snyan rgyan dang dpung rgyan/ bram ze'i rigs dmar khras mgul rgyan dang ska rags/ dmangs rigs ljang khras phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/ gdol pa nag pos do shal byas shing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur par bsam/ mchod pa rnams badzra a mṛ tas bsang*// swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā nas/ shabda pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ gnyen po lha gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos bdag la mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab cing*/

cung rgyas par 'dod na/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// bya khyung rgyal po rta mgrin gsang ba'i bdag /rang bzhin gcig tu nyer bstan khro bo'i gtso// dran pas bgegs dpung 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag cag rnams la deng nas byang chub bar// steng 'og bar gyi gdon bgegs nad la sogs// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing*// mthun rkyen dngos grub yid bzhin stsal du gsol// zhes brjod kyang rung*/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas mnyes bzhin rang gi spyi gtsug tu byon/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ 'dir dbang bskur rgyas gdab byed par spro na spyi ltar byas pa'i rigs bdag mi bskyod pa dang*/ de rjes mchod bstod sogs byas kyang rung mod na'ang*/ snyan brgyud rtsa bar ma byung ba bzhin chad skyon med pas mi dgos so// de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang khyad par gdon dmigs kyis bsal ba gang yin sbyangs shing bsregs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros snod bcud la phog snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs nas gsang bdag gi go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus pa tshur bsdus rang la thim pas yon tan thams cad thob pas sngar bas kyang mthu stobs nus pa cher 'phel bar gyur par bsams nas/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi ha ya grī wa ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags ci nus bzla/ yang res 'ga' snying ga'i sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa me 'od 'bar ba la sems ma yengs par gtad pa'am yi ge rnams klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla ba'ang rung*/ dmigs pa de dag 'tshubs chung zhing dngos grub myur ba dang nus pa skyed pa la bsngags pas rgyun gyi nyams len du bya la/

dmigs bsal gyi nad gdon zhi ba sogs las gzhan sgrub pa skabs su babs tshe de dang bstun pa'i dmigs pa bya lugs tshad thub kyi man ngag bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas nye bar 'ongs pa bzhin nyams su bstar ba dang*/ gzhan don du byed na rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi thig le'i nang ngam 'char ma bde na de'i mdun bsgrub bya gang yin de nyid tha mal pa'i rnam pa'am/ ngo bo bsgrub bya de la rnam pa ming yig dang po'i yi ge'am mi la nṛ yig gam gzugs su legs par gsal btab nas/ hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis de'i nad gdon sdig sgrib spyi bye brag thams cad sbyong ba dang 'od zer gyis srung ba'i go bskon par dmigs pa sogs kha bsgyur shes par byas te sngags bzla/ rang gzhan gang gi don du byed kyang skabs kyi dmigs pa ma yengs pa dang*/ rang nyid lha gsum ngo bo dbyer med pa'i nga rgyal brtan po dang gsal snang la bslab cing*/ lha sku de'ang me long nang gi khro bo'i gzugs brnyan ltar sems kyis btags pa tsam las rang bzhin gyis med par nges pa'i lta ba'i rtsis zin par byas nas zab gsal gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor la gzhol ba dang*/ gdon dang bgegs rigs kyis mtshon pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje'i dmigs pa rnam par bar du dran par byed pa'ang dngos grub myur ba sogs la gal che ba'i gnad kyi don po yin no/

bsnyen pa byed na/ mtshams kyi bya lugs bsnyen yig spyi 'gro ltar la/ grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag bcu bzhi bzla/ thun gcig gi mjug tu gtor ma dbul/ bsnyen pa song nas las sbyor gyi bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas las bzhi'i dmigs pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi bzlas dmigs spyi ltar sbyar la/ sngags kyi mjug tu/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa lta bu'i spel tshig btags pa bsnyen pa'i bcu cha tsam bzlas kyang rung*/ khyad par drag po'i las sbyor gdon 'dul gyi dmigs pa gtso bor byed na/ gza' gdon la rang gi thugs ka nas phyag rdor dang*/ rgyal 'gong la spyi bo'i rta gdong las rta mgrin dang*/ klu la spyi gtsug gi khyung las bya khyung gi tshogs me 'od dang mtshon cha'i char 'bebs pa dpag tu med pa spros te gnod byed thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba'i rgyas gdab/ gtso bor rtsa sngags dang*/ skabs su drag po'i spel tshig gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭa ces sbyar la bzla/ mthar gdon dang gnyen po thams cad 'od gsal du sbyangs te rang la bstim zhing lta ba'i rtsis zin par byas la byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba la 'bad par bya'o// /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas pa'i mthar yig brgya bzlas nas lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// zhes sogs shlo ka gcig la sogs pa'i bstod pa gang rigs kyis bstod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gsang ba'i bdag po 'grub gyur nas zhes sogs dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol byas pa'i mthar/ badzra muḥbadag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa sku'i stod smad nas rim gyis 'od du zhu ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/

de'ang zhabs kyu nas rim gyis nā da'i bar yal nas mi dmigs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsams la/ thun mtshams su'ang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bas spyod lam la 'jug par bya/ gtor 'bul mngon rtogs su dngos su ma byung bas ma byas kyang chad par mi 'gyur mod/ 'grub na phun sum tshogs pas de ltar byed na thun mtha'i mchod bstod kyi rjes der/ gtor ma oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa'ang sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la khro bo dang mngag gzhug pa thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi zhes pa lan gsum dang bdun sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs zhes sogs shlo ka gnyis kyis bstod pa dang*/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab pas dgyes pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes par mos/ de nas mdun gyi mgron rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur par bsam rjes/ bzod gsol sogs sngar bkod pa bzhin tu bya/ de ltar nag po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i gdon rigs rnams 'joms par byed pa'i drag po'i lha gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i yi dam khyad par can 'di nyid lhar bzung ste bsnyen sgrub la 'grus par byas nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub par bya'o// nyer zhi'i go 'phang brnyes kyang bdud sde rnams// thal bar rlog mdzad drag po gsum sgril gyi// sgrub thabs gzhan 'joms nus pa thogs med cing*// sus kyang mi brdzi rdo rje pha lam bzhin// 'di bkod dge bas bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro// 'gal rkyen bar gcod tshogs las rab rgyal zhing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// yid bzhin dus las yol med 'grub gyur cig

/ces dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje pha lam zhes bya ba 'di ni or du su pa'i le don grub kyi bla mar 'gro mi smad rgyud rab 'byams pa byams pa chos 'byor gyis bskul ma byung ba dang*/ don gnyer can gzhan la'ang phan par bsams nas shākya'i dge slong blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga rdo rje'i me phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra pā ṇi ye/ dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇḍa lar sna tshogs padma'i lte bar nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po gcig dgod/ de'i mdun du gtor ma dkar zlum bzhi/ bdag mdun so sor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bsham/ gzhan yang las bum/ rdor dril/ me tog gi snod sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i skur gyur/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa thams cad sngags phreng 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bum pa'i nang gi sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci rigs pa bzla/ hūm̐ lan bdun brjod pas bum nang gi sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa'ang 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par mos/

de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang skal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje pha lam ltar nyams su blangs rjes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ mdun gyi maṇḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma sogs nas/ mthun rkyen yid bzhin dngos grub stsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar rang gi sems nyid dang*/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun bskyed la gnyis su med par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus te thim pas mthu stobs nus byin mchog tu 'bar bar bsams la bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ gtor ma dang po/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes gtso byas pa'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul lo rdo rje slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ gnyis pa'ang bsang sbyang byin brlab rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs mdun bskyed kyi mtha' skor du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi lan gsum/ oṃ shrī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sngon tshe phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di dpal phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar srog snying phul nas bstan pa srung bar dam bcas pa'i srung ma rnams la 'bul lo// rdo rje slob ma'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhu/ gsum pa bsang sbyang byin brlab/ sambha ra lan gsum dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor rgya chen po 'di yul lha gzhi bdag gi tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad spong ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bzhi pa'ang bsang sbyang byin brlab/ sambha ra lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnod cing lan chags pa la sogs pa'i mgron gyi tshogs su gyur pa rnams la sbyin no// bdag cag chos sgrub pa la gnod 'tshe thams cad spongs shig bu lon lan chags sha 'khon thams cad khyer nas gnod sems dang gdug pa'i sems thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod/ gnyis pa rjes gnang dngos ni/

rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma phyi rol du las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ nang du 'ongs pa na bgegs bskrad/ las kyi rdo rjes bskul nas maṇḍal phul/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod gsal gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas nges 'byung dang*/ byang chub sems kyi gtam ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la rgyud dang man ngag rnams nas sgrub pa'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid/ nges pa'i don du gdod ma nas bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa'i go 'phang brnyes su zin kyang*/ thun mong gi gdul bya drang ba'i slad du so so skye bo rnams dang rigs mthun pa'i theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi tshul du bzung ba'i sku tshe de nyid la'ang dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku'i snang ba nam 'dod du gzigs shing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa zhig gsan pa'i snying po snyan brgyud glegs bam rin po che'i chos sde las byung ba dpal phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la slob dpon gyis dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dang da ltar gyi slob dpon tha mi dad pa la skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i spyan sngar skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa 'di nyid kyang bsgrubs zin pa ltar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ slob dpon rang nyid kyang de lta bu'i yi dam lha yi skur gsal ba la sku'i rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba bdag la stsal zhing dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i spyi gtsug gi bya khyung rgyal po'i sku las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sku'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i lus rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ du gyur te slob ma'i spyi bor zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ slob ma'i spyi bor 'khod pa'i oṃ dkar po las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus lha'i skur bsgom pa la dbang ngo zhes brda sprad/ gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gsung gi rjes gnang bdag la stsal zhing dbang bskur du gsol/

de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i spyi gtsug gi rta mgo las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ slob ma'i ngag la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gsung gi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i ngag rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bo āḥdamar por gyur te slob ma'i mgrin par zhugs/ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ slob ma'i lce rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur te rtse lnga la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi ha ya grī ba ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng zhal nas thon slob ma'i khar song a ba dhū tī'i dbyibs brgyud/ gsang gnas nas thon/ bla ma'i gsang gnas nas zhugs te slar yang mgal me ltar 'khor bar mos pa dang bcas slob dpon gyi phreng ba nas bzung ste sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sngags lan mang du bzla/ des ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang ngo*// thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kyi rjes gnang bdag la stsal zhing dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ slob ma'i yid la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i yid rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon por gyur te slob ma'i snying gar zhugs/ hūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs te 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim/ slob ma'i lus stod smad nas rim gyis 'od du zhu/ hūm̐ la thim/ de'ang zhabs kyu nas thig le'i bar du thim pa'i mthar thig le sngon po til 'bru tsam du gyur pa la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad/ slar de nyid kyang mi dmigs pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang ngo*// phrin las kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gcig pu sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba'i don du zhu ba ma lags kyi/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i don du phrin las bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha slob ma'i spyi bor byon par bsams la maṇḍal slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag ste/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi slob ma 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas sems can dpag tu med pa la phan thogs shing*/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol lan gsum/

de nas maṇḍal phyag tu thogs la dmigs pa'i brda sprad pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i spyi gtsug gi bya khyung rgyal po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ zhi byed kyi lha tshogs dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas nad gnod bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sogs sngags mthar shāntiṃ

dpe 'ga' zhig tu shāntiṃ ku ru sogs bris kyang*/ dpe rnying rnams su shāntiṃ ka ra sogs yod cing*/ don du'ang zhi bar mdzad pa'i dngos grub kyi dbang bskur ba zhes sogs su 'gyur bas 'thad par sems/ ka ra siddhi oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sku'i rin po che'i rgyan rnams las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rgyas byed kyi lha tshogs ser po bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par gyur/ sngags mthar ā yurdzñā na puṇye puṣṭiṃ ka ra siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ spyi gtsug gi rta mgo las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ dbang byed kyi lha tshogs dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas sems can thams cad chos la 'god pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sngags mthar wā shaṃ ka ra siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ slar yang bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i sku'i cha thams cad las 'od zer nag po 'phros/ drag byed kyi lha tshogs nag po bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sngags mthar mā raṃ ka ra siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mthar maṇḍal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i yi dam gyi lha gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor rnam par dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod la maṇḍal slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag des sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes bsgom zhing phrin las sgrub pa la dbang ngo*// mjug tu gtso bos maṇḍal deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa rjes ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/

bdag nyid lhar gsal ba la mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ badzra muḥbadag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa sku'i stod smad nas rim gyis 'od du zhu ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu nas rim gyis nā da'i bar yal nas mi dmigs par gyur/ slar yang stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsams la/ bsngo smon dang shis brjod kyis mtshams sbyar te lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar steng gdon gza' dang gnod sbyin gtso bor gyur pa'i gnyen po phyag rdor/ bar gdon rgyal 'gong gi gnyen po rta mgrin/ 'og gdon klu'i gnyen po bya khyung ste/ gnyen po stobs kyi lha drag po gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i yi dam khyad par can 'di'i sgrub thabs tsam snyan brgyud rtsa bar bzhugs mod/ rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar ma gsungs kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig tu zab don gces phreng gi chings sbyor tshul gsungs pa ltar brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag bzhes zin bris su bgyis pa'i dgongs don gsal bar bkod pa'o// zhes pa'ang bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas sbyar ba'i dge bas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal te/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
